speech:
Grizzly Rips, sit down, because I'm not sugarcoating a crumb of this. That was an F. 9 matches, 3 wins, 6 losses, 35 goals conceded. That's 3.89 a match. We lost by four or more three separate times: 0-5 to SydSwny FanClub, 1-5 to pilot grape, and then Inter Hornz put 9 past us. Nine. We woke up in Division 2 with all 3 chances in our pocket, burned every one, got sent down, then burned through Division 3 too. Now we face a relegation match just to stay where we're standing. And four rage quits. Four. We averaged a 7.43 against our usual 7.73, while the folks across from us averaged 7.95. They wanted it more.

buddskees, you quit a match we were winning 4-2. I cannot get my head around that. Your passing fell to 53% against Cuc United when you usually hit 81%, you posted a 6.2 in that 0-5 when you usually bring an 8.1, and your tackle success dropped to 50% from 75%. 5 goals and a 9.3 against Dagestan prove the talent's there, which makes the rest sting worse.

PhogsToffees, you walked out of the 3-9. SydSwny's best forward put up a 10.0 to your 6.6, and you won 0% of your tackles against Cuc United. That 9.6 against BaIIhog was beautiful. I need that player every match, not twice a night.

BellyTb1, two rage quits, both while we were getting hammered, exactly when your team needed you most. You attempted 7 tackles and won zero. You hit 13 of 24 passes against Dagestan, and your 6.91 sits well under your usual 7.51. Credit where it's due: 6 assists. You can see a pass. Now see a runner.

tuxedo_slide, you passed 61% overall, 7 of 13 against Cuc United, won 4 of 18 tackles, and scored a 5.8 against pilot grape. But you never quit, and those 2 assists against viscabarca28 were your most in 18 matches. That matters.

Alright. Deep breath. When I was a kid, my granddad's tractor threw a belt in the middle of a hay field with a storm rolling in. He didn't kick the tire or stomp back to the house. He knelt in the dirt, fixed what was broke, and finished that row by lantern light. That's us tomorrow. Our problem is defense, and defense is fixable. Track your runner all the way into the box. When we lose it, the nearest player presses for 3 to 5 seconds and everybody else shuts the passing lanes. Get stuck in, because even 1 tackle won in 8 pays its way.

And here's the good news: we don't even need to win. A draw keeps us in Division 3. We scored 21 goals today, and 6 of our 9 points came in the back half of the night, so the fight's in there. Yesterday was a C, today was an F, and tomorrow is a blank page. I believe in every single one of y'all. Show up, stay in, and let's go fix that belt.
